maddeler.e:
استجنسا (form X)
# اِسْتَجْنَسَا (istajnasā) /is.tad͡ʒ.na.saː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَجْنَسَ (istajnasa)
# اُسْتُجْنِسَا (ustujnisā) /us.tud͡ʒ.ni.saː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَجْنَسَ (istajnasa)
# اِسْتَجْنِسَا (istajnisā) /is.tad͡ʒ.ni.saː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَجْنَسَ (istajnasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
